mapper.select: select * from edu_action_plan where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
select * from edu_action_plan where user_id=#{userId} order by create_time desc
select * from edu_action_plan where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' order by update_time desc limit 1
select * from edu_action_plan_item where plan_id=#{planId} and user_id=#{userId} order by sort_order,id
mapper.update: update edu_action_plan set status='ACTIVE',update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='DRAFT'
update edu_action_plan set status='ARCHIVED',update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')
update edu_action_plan set status='ARCHIVED',update_time=sysdate() where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
update edu_action_plan_item set status=#{status},completed_at=case when #{status}='COMPLETED' then sysdate() else null end,update_time=sysdate() where id=#{itemId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select * from edu_action_plan_item where id=#{itemId} and user_id=#{userId}
